import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_214/context/csv/set_translations.csv')

# Get all Commander set codes from the database
commander_codes = ['C13', 'C14', 'C15', 'C16', 'C17', 'C18', 'C19', 'C20', 'CM1', 'CM2', 'CMA', 'CMD', 'OC13', 'OC14', 'OC15', 'OC16', 'OC17', 'OC18', 'OC19', 'OCM1', 'OCMD', 'PCMD', 'ZNC']

# Filter for Brazilian Portuguese translations
brazilian_portuguese = df[(df['language'] == 'Portuguese (Brazil)') & (df['setCode'].isin(commander_codes))]

# Count distinct set codes
count = brazilian_portuguese['setCode'].nunique()
print(f"Commander sets with Brazilian Portuguese translations: {count}")
print(f"Set codes: {sorted(brazilian_portuguese['setCode'].unique())}")
